footer.tagline: Bridging generations through collaborative quests, AI mentoring, and shared wisdom.

landing.seoTitle: Rootwise — Activities With Parents & Grandparents | Intergenerational Platform
landing.seoDescription: Discover meaningful activities to do with your parents, grandparents or grandchildren. Rootwise connects generations through shared Quests, AI mentoring and community — combat loneliness and build lasting family bonds. Free to join.
landing.heroDescription: Rootwise pairs life experience with modern skills. Create your profile, join a quest, and grow with a mentor and a community that cares.
landing.heroImageAlt: A younger person and an older person laughing together at a laptop — bridging generations through shared learning
landing.heroImageCaption: Real connections. Real learning. Across generations.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Three steps to your first quest
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From sign-up to meaningful connection in minutes
landing.step1Desc: Tell us who you are. Are you looking to share your life experience (Sage) or learn new skills (Seeker)? Build a profile to find the right match.
landing.step2Desc: Pick a topic and connect. Choose a specific activity—like “Fixing a Camera” or “Learning TikTok”—and start a guided video call with built-in conversation starters.
landing.step3Desc: Capture the wisdom. Save the best moments from the call, earn XP for helping others, and build a digital timeline of skills and stories.
landing.examplesSubtitle: Here are real examples of activities people do on Rootwise.
landing.exampleCookingDesc: Grandma Malle teaches how to bake real sourdough bread in a kitchen video call.
landing.exampleTechDesc: Markus (19) teaches grandpa how to avoid online scams.
landing.exampleHistoryDesc: Ene (75) shows old photos on camera and shares stories from the 1980 Olympics.
landing.whySubtitle: Society is fractured by age silos. Rootwise is the bridge.
landing.problem1Desc: Loneliness is a global epidemic. Rootwise replaces passive scrolling with active, meaningful human partnership across generations.
landing.problem2Desc: Millions of years of life experience are locked away. We turn those memories into actionable quests that preserve cultural legacy.
landing.problem3Desc: No more "digital divide". Seniors teach soft skills and history; youth teach modern technology and digital leverage.
landing.feature1Desc: Collaborative challenges that pair different generations to learn from each other.
landing.feature2Desc: Powered by Gemini AI — your personal guide for learning, quests, and growth.
landing.feature3Desc: Join groups around shared interests — cooking, tech, gardening, storytelling, and more.
landing.feature4Desc: Earn experience points, level up, and track your wisdom journey over time.
landing.conversionDesc: Create a profile, pick your first quest, and get paired with a mentor. No paywall to get started.
landing.conversionReadingAlt: An older woman peacefully reading a book on a sunny porch — wisdom worth sharing
landing.faq1A: Yes. Core features are free and you can start without a credit card.
landing.faq2A: Your profile and conversation settings are in your control. You can change visibility or remove content anytime.
landing.faq3A: Create an account, choose roles and interests, then join a quest. Your first recommendations arrive automatically.
landing.finalCtaDesc: Join the movement where every interaction is an investment in our collective future. Start your first quest today.
